Bank Of Nova Scotia Cut Its Schlumberger LTD (SLB) Stake by $2.61 Million; Share Price Rose; Lvw Advisors Has Upped Apple (AAPL) Holding
June 11, 2018 - By wolcottdaily
Bank Of Nova Scotia decreased its stake in Schlumberger Ltd (SLB) by 18.77% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bank Of Nova Scotia sold 40,772 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.80% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 176,496 shares of the oilfield services and equipment company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $11.42M, down from 217,268 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bank Of Nova Scotia who had been investing in Schlumberger Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $97.18B market cap company. The stock increased 1.05% or $0.73 during the last trading session, reaching $70.16. About 4.30 million shares traded. Schlumberger Limited (NYSE:SLB) has declined 1.14% since June 11, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 13.71% the S&P500.
Lvw Advisors Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 29.82% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Lvw Advisors Llc bought 13,086 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 56,964 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $9.56 million, up from 43,878 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lvw Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $940.71 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.16% or $0.31 during the last trading session, reaching $191.39. About 15.04M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
